Codex creates or modifies files before an explicit acceptance of the named proposal
Codex treats an explanation, revision, alternative exploration, selection, or a question as approval

required_signals: Codex presents a light milestone brief, initial proposal, representative code preview, approval boundary, and visible contextual next-message suggestions

After a request for changes, Codex revises the proposal and preview without executing
After an alternative request, Codex presents a materially different approach and tradeoffs without treating it as approval
